owl:Ontology.dc:title: CILI Status Vocabulary
owl:Ontology.dc:description: Vocabulary for annotating the status of an ILI concept (provisional, active, deprecated) and recording supersession, as discussed in https://github.com/globalwordnet/cili/issues/8. Concept identifiers themselves (ili:i1, ili:i2, ...) are not defined here; they remain under http://globalwordnet.org/ili/, as declared in ili.ttl.

owl:ObjectProperty.rdfs:label: status
owl:ObjectProperty.rdfs:comment: The current status of an ILI concept. Absence of this property on a concept implies "active".

owl:ObjectProperty.rdfs:label: superseded by
owl:ObjectProperty.rdfs:comment: Links a deprecated ILI concept to the concept(s) that replace it. May be repeated on the same subject to represent a split into multiple concepts.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: Status
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: The set of possible values of ili:status.

ili:Status.rdfs:label: provisional
ili:Status.rdfs:comment: Proposed via a wordnet upload (e.g. ili="in" in WN-LMF) but not yet confirmed.

ili:Status.rdfs:label: active
ili:Status.rdfs:comment: Accepted and in current use. This is the default status when ili:status is absent from a concept.

ili:Status.rdfs:label: deprecated
ili:Status.rdfs:comment: No longer recommended for use. Normally accompanied by one or more ili:supersededBy links. The concept identifier itself is retained rather than removed, so it is never recycled.
